bio.text: Alonna Berry represents District 20 in the Delaware House of Representatives; her legislative service began in 2025.

She worked in Governor John Carney's office as Director of Community and Family Services and later as Senior Policy Advisor for Health, Equity, and Education, and was Delaware's first Statewide Trauma-Informed Care Coordinator.
Berry is Executive Director of the Delaware Center for Justice and launched the Bryan Allen Stevenson School of Excellence in Georgetown.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Syracuse University and is a doctoral candidate at Wilmington University.
